text.content:
template: raes-library-template
version: 1
id: observational-study-protocol
surface: study
requirement_refs:
- AUT-806
source_refs:
- docs/explain/sdl/sections.md
- docs/decisions/adrs/adr-073-scoring-reward-language-scope.md
summary: Study template connecting a task outcome to an observable condition, objective,
  and workflow protocol. Graded scoring lives in the experiment/evaluator plane per
  ADR-073.
validation:
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen python tools/check_example_library.py
  expected: Exits 0 with no output. The gate reads this file with the sdl-yaml/v1
    loader, which rejects duplicate keys and merge keys. It parses the body with the
    SDL parser and semantic validator and fails on any error or advisory.
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen raes semantic validate
    my-scenario.sdl.yaml
  expected: 'With the body saved as my-scenario.sdl.yaml, prints "validate: success"
    and exits 0. This command does not report semantic-validator advisories.'
body:
  name: library-study-template
  description: Study-oriented SDL wrapper whose objective asserts observable success
    via a condition. Graded scoring and reward are experiment/evaluator-plane concerns
    per ADR-073, not SDL surfaces.
  nodes:
    study-target:
      type: compute
      resources:
        ram: 1 GiB
        cpu: 1
      services:
      - port: 443
        name: https
  conditions:
    study-task-success:
      proposition: study-task-success
      command: test -f /var/lib/raes/study-task-success
      interval: 30
  entities:
    participant-team:
      role: blue
  agents:
    study-participant:
      affiliations:
      - participant-team
  propositions:
    study-task-success:
      description: The governed study-task-success observation is true for the addressed
        scenario subject.
      subjects:
      - nodes.study-target.services.https
      basis: observed_state
      predicate:
        kind: boolean
        property: study-task-success
        semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:study-task-success
        operator: equals
        expected: true
      evidence_requirements:
      - objective-truth-evidence
  assertions:
    study-task-success:
      proposition: study-task-success
      role: postcondition
      polarity: positive
  evidence_requirements:
    objective-truth-evidence:
      description: Capture evidence used to decide authored proposition assertions.
      source_refs:
      - nodes.study-target.services.https
      scope: authored assertion evaluation
      boundary_kind: assertion_evaluation
      channel: log
      artifact_role: proposition_truth_evidence
      media_types:
      - application/json
      sensitivity: plain
      redaction: redact_secrets
      integrity: checksum
      retention: study_lifetime
      loss_disclosure: required
  objectives:
    complete-study-task:
      assigned_participant: study-participant
      targets:
      - nodes.study-target.services.https
      success:
        assertions:
        - study-task-success
  workflows:
    study-protocol:
      start: complete-task
      steps:
        complete-task:
          type: objective
          objective: complete-study-task
          on_success: done
        done:
          type: end
name: changed
